verdict.rationale: Lambda has a public pricing page that advertises "clear, straightforward pricing" for Instances, 1-Click Clusters and Superclusters. It also offers self-serve B200/H100/A100/GH200 instances billed by hourly usage in one-minute increments, so on-demand rates appear to be published without a sales conversation. However, the evidence never shows actual per-GPU-hour figures or confirms that every GPU type is listed, and reserved capacity at the lowest prices requires contacting sales. Missing for 10: concrete published per-GPU-hour prices for each GPU type, confirmation that all instance types are covered, and public pricing for reserved capacity without contacting sales.
